title: Renewal Cushion Share Schedule — Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Schedule.** For a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement renewed within its term, the renewal cushion share depends on how many energy lines were billed for cycles starting later than the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date: 0.50 when there are 10 or more, 0.25 when there are at least 6 but fewer than 10, and zero when there are fewer than 6.

The records counted are the energy charge lines on the agreement's bill ledger with a billing cycle start in that window; service fee lines and credit lines are not counted.

| Energy lines billed for cycles in the window | Renewal cushion share |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 0.50 |
| 6 to 9 | 0.25 |
| 0 to 5 | zero |

### Cases (hypothetical; acceptance date 15 August 2025)

- Energy lines for cycles starting 16 August 2024 through 16 July 2025, one per month: 12 lines, share 0.50.
- An agreement whose supply began in January 2025, with 7 energy lines in the window: share 0.25.
- An energy line whose cycle starts 15 August 2024 is outside the window and is not counted.
